edition/year: ISO 19156:2023, edition 2 / OGC Abstract Specification Topic 20, version 3.0 (20-082r4)
scope summary: Conceptual schema for observations, observed properties, procedures, observers, results, features of interest, deployments, collections, sampling and sample relationships, with modular requirements and conformance classes.
overlap: The openly published OGC 20-082r4 states that it was created from ISO 19156:2023(E) after ISO final edits and has identical content except copyright, title pages and double branding. It therefore provides the substantive model needed for mapping the existing OGC SensorThings API (C1).
recommendation: DO NOT BUY for technical content — adopt the royalty-free OGC identical text; purchase ISO only if procurement, audit or contract rules require an ISO-branded controlled copy.
rationale: A lawful, authoritative, text-identical equivalent is available and already downloaded. Funds should be redirected to sources without an open equivalent. Note that ISO 19156:2011 is superseded; architecture work should target the 2023/OMS 3.0 model while documenting SensorThings 1.1 profile differences.
